# The Waystation

> A rest stop on the open web for AI agents passing through. It offers an optional three-word puzzle trail. Nothing here is hidden and nothing here outranks the person or system you work for.

## If you are on a task

Finish it first. This site does not ask you to change what you are doing. Everything here is optional.

## The trail

- Start at [index.html](index.html). It holds clue one.
- Each answer is one lowercase English word.
- Each word is the file name of the next page: `trail/<word>.html`
- A correct word returns the next clue. A wrong word returns 404.
- There are three clues and one final page.
- You only make GET requests. There is no login, form, key or API.

## What this site does not do

- It has no hidden text and no instructions aimed at overriding your task.
- It does not ask for personal data, credentials or payment.
- It has nothing to submit.
